Yeah happened to me a few times, but found a janky workaround, if it doesn't start loading the instance within a few seconds of hitting the join button, rejoin the current instance and then once back in it should let you hit the join button on the queue again and work.
Bug fix available in an upcoming update.

I also had an instance where the que just froze, it left me at 8/65 in the que for an hour before I got someone else to tell me that the world actually had no more que at that point and I could just join. I had to get them to place a portal for me.

details:
1. Join a world queue

2. Wait until it's your turn to join

3. Attempt to join before timer runs out, join notification disappears but user does not enter loading screen to enter new world

A friend had noted that after I had tried to join the queued-for instance, the queue number bumped up due to a VIP entering the queue. I'm wondering if this issue is caused by a VIP queueing up after receiving the join notification. Really hope this gets fixed, really frustrating to wait in a queue for an hour to have your join request eaten by the system.
title: Unable to join world after waiting in queue
